# netbox_front_port_template (Resource)

A front port template of a device type or module type (dcim.frontporttemplate), mapped position by position onto rear port templates of the same type.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/frontporttemplate/):

> A template for a front-facing pass-through port that will be created on all instantiations of the parent device type. See the [front port](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/frontport/) documentation for more detail.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_manufacturer" "test" {
  name = "test-manufacturer"
}

resource "netbox_device_type" "test" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.test.id
  model           = "test-device-type"
}

resource "netbox_rear_port_template" "test" {
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.test.id
  name           = "test-rear-port-template"
  type           = "8p8c"
  positions      = 4
}

resource "netbox_front_port_template" "test" {
  device_type_id     = netbox_device_type.test.id
  name               = "test-front-port-template"
  type               = "8p8c"
  rear_port_id       = netbox_rear_port_template.test.id
  rear_port_position = 2
  color_hex          = "ff0000"
  label              = "test-label"
  description        = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Port type as its NetBox slug, e.g. 8p8c, lc, mpo (any of NetBox's port type choices).

### Optional

- `color_hex` (String) RGB color in hex (e.g. ff0000).
- `description` (String)
- `device_type_id` (Number) Id of the device type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `module_type_id` (Number) Id of the module type. Set exactly one of device_type_id and module_type_id; NetBox rejects both and neither.
- `positions` (Number) Number of positions on the front port, at least the number of rear_ports mappings. NetBox checks a lower value against the mappings it already holds, so remove mappings in one apply and lower positions in the next.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) Rear port of a single-position front port: the same as rear_ports = [{position = 1, rear_port_id = ..., rear_port_position = ...}]. Conflicts with rear_ports and with positions > 1.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on rear_port_id. Requires rear_port_id.
- `rear_ports` (Attributes Set) Mappings of the front port's positions onto rear port templates of the same device type or module type, one object per position. Derived from rear_port_id and rear_port_position when those are set; an empty set, or neither form, leaves the port unmapped. Changing the set recreates every mapping, since NetBox 4.6 rejects an update that resends an existing one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rear_ports))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `url` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--rear_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rear_ports`

Required:

- `position` (Number) Position on the front port, 1-based and unique per port.
- `rear_port_id` (Number) Id of the rear port template the position maps to.
- `rear_port_position` (Number) Position on that rear port, 1-based; each rear port position takes one mapping.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_front_port_template.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_front_port_template.test 123
```
